hint: Grouping organisms based on similarities and differences.
easy_answer: Biological classification is the systematic grouping of organisms according to similarities and differences.

hint: To study and identify them systematically.
easy_answer: Classification makes the study, identification and comparison of animals easier.

hint: A balanced arrangement of body parts around an axis or plane.
easy_answer: Symmetry describes the balanced arrangement of body parts in an organism.

hint: Body parts are arranged around a central axis.
easy_answer: In radial symmetry, similar body parts are arranged around a central axis.

hint: The body can be divided into similar right and left halves.
easy_answer: Bilateral symmetry allows one plane to divide the body into approximately equal right and left halves.

hint: Body develops from two germ layers.
easy_answer: Diploblastic animals develop from two primary germ layers.

hint: Body develops from three germ layers.
easy_answer: Triploblastic animals develop from three primary germ layers.

hint: A fluid-filled body cavity lined by mesoderm.
easy_answer: A coelom is a body cavity completely or substantially lined by mesoderm.

hint: Animals with a vertebral column.
easy_answer: Vertebrates are animals that possess a backbone or vertebral column.

hint: Animals without a vertebral column.
easy_answer: Invertebrates are animals that do not possess a vertebral column.

hint: They have numerous pores in the body.
easy_answer: Poriferans have many pores and a canal system for water flow.

hint: They possess stinging cells.
easy_answer: Cnidarians possess specialized stinging cells called cnidoblasts or cnidocytes.

hint: Their body is segmented.
easy_answer: Annelids have a bilaterally symmetrical, segmented body.

hint: They have jointed appendages and an exoskeleton.
easy_answer: Arthropods have a segmented body, jointed appendages and an exoskeleton.

hint: They generally have a soft unsegmented body.
easy_answer: Molluscs generally have a soft body, often protected by a shell.

hint: Adults generally show radial symmetry and have a water vascular system.
easy_answer: Echinoderms possess a water vascular system and adults generally show radial symmetry.

question_text: What is the main feature of chordates?
hint: Presence of a notochord at least during development.
easy_answer: Chordates possess a notochord at least at some stage of development.

hint: A vertebrate group in which females generally possess mammary glands.
easy_answer: Mammals are vertebrates characterized by mammary glands and hair at some stage of life.

hint: It lays eggs that develop outside the mother's body.
easy_answer: An oviparous animal lays eggs, with development occurring outside the mother's body.

hint: It gives birth to young ones after internal development.
easy_answer: A viviparous animal gives birth to young ones that develop inside the mother's body.
